notes: Ryzen PC (192.168.1.100 / 10.77.77.1, Windows 11 Pro 26200, Docker Desktop) service manifest for the household observability pilot. Schema = threadripper/config/monitoring/dependencies.json version 1 plus the A§1.3 superset fields (tier, freshness_s, notes, probe_from). Written 2026-09-16 by the M3 evaluator worker; owner: iot-backend (host), grafana (grafana*, pilot containers), Networking (net-pollers).

Evidence: iot-backend/docker-compose.yml (mosquitto :1883/:9001, influxdb :8086, telegraf), iot-backend/telegraf/telegraf.conf (inputs.mqtt_consumer servers tcp://mosquitto:1883, outputs.influxdb_v2 http://influxdb:8086), grafana/docker-compose.yml (grafana :3000, external network iot-backend_iot-network), Networking/docker-compose.yml (net-pollers on iot-backend_iot-network writing http://influxdb:8086), iot-backend/scripts/install-recovery-task.ps1 + docs/recovery-job-2026-09-15.md (task 'IoT Backend Verified Encrypted Recovery' 03:15 Pacific, D:/Backups/iot-backend/status.json + latest.json), grafana/tools/install_recovery_task.ps1 + docs/recovery-checkpoint-2026-09-11.md (task 'Grafana Verified Encrypted Recovery' 03:30 Pacific, D:/Backups/grafana/latest.json), grafana/pilot/CONTRACT.md compose table (loki, log-gateway, household-evaluator, security-aggregator, obs-test-probe), grafana/docs/household-observability/inventory.md (guides container seen live in docker ps, 2026-09-16).

D11: the Telegraf Docker container input is omitted from the first pilot, so a node whose only check is docker_container is declared unprobed:true (the check stays declared for the Ryzen service_health.py port to enable later). Nodes with an http/tcp check are probed. Checks carrying probe_from=household-evaluator are executed by the household evaluator container itself on iot-backend_iot-network (it can reach influxdb, mosquitto, grafana and obs-test-probe by service name; the host port cannot see obs-test-probe, which publishes no port).

Staged (grafana/pilot, docker-compose.pilot.yml, unapplied as of 2026-09-16): alloy, telegraf-host, loki, log-gateway, household-evaluator, security-aggregator, obs-test-probe. They are declared expected_state=active so the household evaluator renders them unknown (never healthy) until the attended apply step; flip nothing here at apply time.

tcp is not in the A§1.1 Windows check-type list (docker_container, http, scheduled_task, file_mtime, disk_free, windows_service); it is used once (mosquitto :1883 has no HTTP endpoint) and reported as a deviation in evidence/m3/evaluator-manifests-2026-09-16.md.

Not declared (not evidenced in compose files/docs read for this manifest): the 9 mcp-grafana-* sidecars (stale, TODO 21/36), the Hyper-V/WSL runtime, the NordLynx VPN, the Windows Task Scheduler itself. Docker Desktop's engine service name is not evidenced in any repo, so 'docker' is unprobed rather than guessed.

Disk thresholds on os are proposals by this manifest, not a documented owner contract: C: hosts the Docker Desktop VM disk (65.5 GB free / 249 GB on 2026-09-16); D: hosts the recovery checkpoints with a documented 20 GiB free reserve (iot-backend/docs/recovery-and-continuity-2026-09-11.md).

services.title: Ryzen Windows host (C: Docker VM disk, D: checkpoints)
Docker Desktop engine (WSL2 VM)
services.notes: No direct engine probe in the first pilot: the Docker input is omitted (D11) and the named pipe needs docker-users. The Windows service com.docker.service ('Docker Desktop Service') exists but was observed Stopped while every container was running (read-only Get-Service on the Ryzen, 2026-09-16 22:40 UTC), so it is not an engine-up signal. Engine state is therefore INFERRED by the household evaluator: healthy while any probed container on this host reports fresh healthy/degraded, otherwise unknown (never failed: all containers stopped, as after the 2026-09-15 reboot, is not proof the engine is down).

services.notes: Every path except POST /loki/api/v1/push answers 405/403, so a rejected GET is the healthy reading. TLS is issued by the gateway-local CA: the probe must trust pilot/secrets/gateway/ca.crt or report unknown, never disable verification.
